ordinary_frame.basis: This remains a Mass. The normal formulary appoints Oratio super populum after Postcommunion and before dismissal (Missale Romanum 1962, printed p. 127, numbered text 815; artifact PDF p. 208). The held generic Ordinary frame has no declared place for this prayer, so that frame is unavailable. The Propers remain in their printed order.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Cordibus nostris, quaesumus, Domine, gratiam tuam benignus infunde: ut,
peccata nostra castigatione voluntaria cohibentes, temporaliter potius
maceremur, quam suppliciis deputemur aeternis. Per Dominum.

propers.text:
